title: Freekeh and Vegetable Stew
subtitle: with lemony tahini
description: A one-pot freekeh stew with carrots, onion, garlic and sage, served with lemony tahini and crushed fresh tomatoes.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Fry the grated carrots and chopped onion for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden.
Add the chilli, crushed garlic and sage and stir. Add the freekeh, stir and fry for 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and stir.

Pour in water to about 2 cm above the contents and continue cooking for 30-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the water is absorbed and you need to scrape the wheat a little from the bottom of the pot. Add more liquid if needed.
Serve hot with lemony tahini and fresh crushed tomatoes.
